stem:
Bharat starts factorising 60 as 6 × 10 and wants a complete prime factorisation.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: Stop at 6 × 10, because those factors are already named composite factors.
Rewrite only 6 as 2 × 3 and leave 10 as it is.
Continue until every factor is prime: 60 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 5.
Choose 60 itself as the answer, because 60 is the largest number printed in the stem.

teacher.key_rationale: Prime factorisation continues until only primes remain: 60 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 5. Stopping at composite factors swaps the goal. Leaving 10 unfactored omits the continue-until-prime condition. The printed 60 is not the factorisation.
